Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied comparative logic when interpreting the retrieved birth dates. Despite correctly gathering that Aryeh Ben-Eliezer was born in 1913 and Jason Pociask in 1983, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Pociask is older. This reverses the chronological order (earlier birth year indicates older age) and led to the wrong final answer.
